crossRefs.keyword: Mazzaroth. or, the twelve signs.Probably the same as {mazzaloth.}

crossRefs.note: He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the rooms of the south.

translations.web: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?
translations.bsb: Can you bring forth the constellations in their seasons or lead out the Bear and her cubs?
translations.kjv: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?
translations.asv: Canst thou lead forth the Mazzaroth in their season? Or canst thou guide the Bear with her train?
